thread:
nina: Heads up: deploying ranking-service v7. Release changes: updated tokenization + routing fallback. Feature flag `rank_v7` will be staged: 0% -> 5% Canary (20m) pinned to model=7.1 -> 25% (30m) -> 100% gradual. Change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. @deploy-bot start canary when green.

deploy-bot: Canary run started (id=canary-5257003210). Applied rank_v7=5% and pinned model=7.1 to cohort. Logs: https://ci.internal/artifacts/ranking/v7/5257003210

carlos: Note: routing fallback may route to legacy ranker for long docs; ensure canary includes a mix of long docs to test fallback.

emma: Adding auto-pause: hold rollout if rerank_error_rate > 0.3% for 10m or if fallback_rate > 5% for 5m. Also will add a jittered delay between steps to avoid thundering.

mleng: Quick check: model=7.1 includes a new tokenizer token boundary change. Might affect downstream confidence scores. Recommend keeping score threshold for A/B at 0.02 lower for canary.

sre: I'll watch infra-side metrics for queue saturation and tail latency.

devops-bot: Canary metrics (t+12m): rerank_errors=0.04%, fallback_rate=1.2%, p95=180ms. No holds.

nina: Proceed to ramp -> 25%.

deploy-bot: Executing ramp: rank_v7=25%. Command: `/ff set rank_v7 25 --note="step-to-25"`

devops-bot: Canary metrics (t+25m): rerank_errors=0.67%, fallback_rate=6.1%, p95=260ms. Alert: fallback_rate > 5% for 5m.

nina: Pausing. Let's reduce to 10% while we inspect samples. Can someone dump sample request IDs from the canary cohort (10m window)?

carlos: Dumping samples: request_ids=[r_8712, r_8713, r_8720, r_8735,...] saved to https://logs.internal/requests/canary-5257003210/sample-dump.json

mleng: From samples, tokenization mismatch found on long-docs with many unicode emojis. I can push a quick patch to tokenizer to fallback to legacy splitting for emoji sequences.

emma: If mleng patches tokenizer, we should re-run canary with patch pinned to cohort. Suggest we set rank_v7=10% and pin tokenizer-version=legacy-1 for that cohort.

nina: Agreed. I'll hold deployment and coordinate canary patch. Command to apply: `/ff set rank_v7 10 --note="reduce-and-pin-tokenizer"` then `/model pin ranking-service tokenizer=legacy-1 cohort=canary-5257003210`

deploy-bot: Applied rank_v7=10% and queued tokenizer pin.

devops-bot: Post-change metrics (t+38m): rerank_errors=0.12%, fallback_rate=2.0%, p95=190ms. Good stabilization.

nina: OK we'll stay at 10% and schedule a slow ramp tomorrow in lower-traffic window. Please add notes to release: two targeted changes (tokenizer fallback + routing fallback tweak).

sre: I'll keep monitoring overnight and set a soft SLA margin.

nina: Thanks team. Opening a short follow-up doc for the roll: https://docs.internal/deploys/ranking/v7/5257003210. Closing thread.
